194:t_1:257.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Where are you going, $$アルト$$!?」

194:t_1:258.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm...! I'm going to save those two with my own hands!」

194:t_1:264.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What are you doing, $$ノノ$$!? Don't run off on your own!」

194:t_1:266.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What is here? Why did you come here?」

194:t_1:267.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I don't know... $$ノノ$$'s feet just moved on their own...」

194:t_1:268.en:
$$ラルク$$
「H-hey... What are you going to do?」

194:t_1:269.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm going to open this door.」

194:t_1:270.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Did you sense something on the other side?」

194:t_2:3.en: ～$$ネオ・アルカトラズ$$　Detention Facility～

194:t_2:5.en:
$$ランカ$$
($$シェリル$$ has... been singing all this time... But... I...)

194:t_2:7.en:
$$シェリル$$
「$$アルト$$! You came for us!」

194:t_2:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「I heard your song through the $$フォールドクォーツ$$ earring.」

194:t_2:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「Do you know where $$ランカ$$ is?」

194:t_2:10.en:
$$シェリル$$
「She's right here with me.」

194:t_2:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm glad you're safe... The Captain and I have been worried about you all this time.」

194:t_2:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「We're getting out of here now. The $$クォーター$$ is here too.」

194:t_2:15.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll go ahead! $$シェリル$$, I'm counting on you to look after $$ランカ$$!」

194:t_3:3.en: ～$$サイデリアル$$　$$ターミナル・ベース$$～

194:t_3:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「I've been waiting, $$シモン$$. Waiting for you guys to join us.」

194:t_3:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「The $$新世界大陸$$ was busy fighting $$サイデリアル$$ too. We couldn't get away easily.」

194:t_3:6.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But with $$超銀河グレンラガン$$'s power, couldn't you blow the Empire away in no time?」

194:t_3:7.en:
$$シモン$$
「...They took $$超銀河ダイグレン$$ from us.」

194:t_3:9.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「It can't land on Earth. We left $$ダヤッカ$$, Princess $$ニア$$ and the others aboard and returned to the $$新世界大陸$$ with just our $$ガンメン$$s...」

194:t_3:10.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「We were fighting the Empire there, but they resorted to a dirty trick.」

194:t_3:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Was it $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$?」

194:t_3:12.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah... He took the people of the $$新世界大陸$$ hostage and demanded we hand over $$超銀河ダイグレン$$.」

194:t_3:13.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「$$ロシウ$$ struggled with the decision. The hostages' lives mattered, of course, but giving it up meant losing our hope...」

194:t_3:14.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「In the end, $$ニア$$'s words convinced $$ロシウ$$ to hand it over.」

194:t_3:16.en:
$$シモン$$
「She said we can get our hope back, but we can't bring back lost lives...」

194:t_3:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We can't bring back lost lives, huh...」

194:t_3:18.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「$$ダヤッカ$$, Princess $$ニア$$ and the others fell into enemy hands along with $$超銀河ダイグレン$$.」

194:t_3:19.en:
$$甲児$$
「Did they release the hostages, then?」

194:t_3:21.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「But his $$スフィア$$'s power had amplified the hatred sleeping in their hearts.」

194:t_3:23.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That bastard... He pulled that trick again...!」

194:t_3:25.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「We've isolated them. We couldn't control them any other way...」

194:t_3:27.en:
$$シモン$$
「After that, $$ロシウ$$ fortified our defenses and switched entirely to fighting defensively.」

194:t_3:28.en:
$$シモン$$
「He had to do it to protect everyone, but we'll never end this war that way.」

194:t_3:29.en:
$$ギミー$$
「That's why we were heading for $$ラース・バビロン$$, where the Empire's top guy is.」

194:t_3:30.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Then $$ロシウ$$ told us about you, and we came here to join you.」

194:t_3:31.en:
$$ギミー$$
「If we'd joined up a little sooner, we could've helped rescue the prisoners too.」

194:t_3:32.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「No... As it turned out, your presence let us deal a major psychological blow to $$ギルター・ベローネ$$ as well.」

194:t_3:33.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Welcome aboard, $$シモン$$. Having you guys here is like gaining ten thousand allies.」

194:t_3:34.en:
$$シモン$$
「The same goes for us. With you all here, there's nothing to fear.」

194:t_3:35.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Now that we've gathered this much strength, our only target is the capital, $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

194:t_3:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「Speaking of new strength, where's $$ノリコ$$...?」

194:t_3:37.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「She's over there arguing with $$ノノ$$.」

194:t_3:38.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I already told you...! I'm in the Top Squadron! I don't know anything about $$トップレス$$!」

194:t_3:39.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then why do you pilot a $$バスターマシン$$!?」

194:t_3:40.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$ is humanity's hope! Big Sis and I burn our lives to turn it into a blazing flame!」

194:t_3:41.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You even have a Big Sis! How much more are you going to copy $$ノノ$$ and her friends!?」

194:t_3:42.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You say that, but you're only a trainee. You have no right to speak for the $$トップレス$$.」

194:t_3:44.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So you're this girl's Big Sis.」

194:t_3:45.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She just calls me that on her own.」

194:t_3:46.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Let me introduce myself properly. I'm $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$... I look forward to working with you.」

194:t_3:47.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I'm $$ラルク・メルク・マール$$. You're my senior in $c.」

194:t_3:48.en:
$$ノノ$$
「You just went and made friends with $$ノノ$$'s Big Sis...! Besides, I don't like your name!」

194:t_3:50.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That's right! $$ノリコ$$... It sounds like $$ノノリリ$$!」
